svg.title: Searchlight results to date
svg.desc: How the Searchlight test works, four findings with their evidence (pass rates with 95% intervals for search vendors on two benchmarks and two coding agents, and how the agents searched), and the caveats for reading them.

svg.text: language, and codex leaned on site: filters

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (31–67% of its vendor queries). Agents often

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: skipped search and opened URLs they remembered.

svg.text: · 18–42 runs per arm: intervals are wide, and adjacent positions are not rankings.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: · Each vendor ran through its own MCP server at a pinned version and default settings. Direct APIs, other modes and other tools were not tested.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: · Grading used validators and blinded model judges (Claude; codex as a second judge on the gap bench). Vendor spend was only partly metered.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: · Search behavior comes from 1629 logged queries; its links to pass rates are correlations.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
